reason: I already learn every dish free from TikTok and YouTube before bed, so I'd maybe try the free 5 dishes, but paying 99 baht up front for dishes that don't exist yet is not something I'd do this month. That's two or three meals for me.
objection: My kitchen is tiny and I only have one pan. Massaman and braised stuff take long and need more than I have, and the free clips already show me tom yum and pad see ew for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If the free dishes actually fix my mistakes on one pan and I cook them a few times, then the pack being one-pan recipes I can see first would get me to pay.
